name: Middlebury Stereo Dataset
description: A collection of stereo image pairs and ground-truth disparity maps across multiple datasets, including scenes captured under varied lighting and exposures. The Middlebury stereo website grants permission to use and publish its images and disparity maps.
citation: Scharstein, D., Hirschmüller, H., Kitajima, Y., Krathwohl, G., Nesic, N., Wang, X., & Westling, P. (2014). High-resolution stereo datasets with subpixel-accurate ground truth. German Conference on Pattern Recognition (GCPR 2014). https://vision.middlebury.edu/stereo/data/

license.notes: The site grants permission to use and publish images and disparity maps; no standardized license identifier is published.
